title: Mammoth Biosciences
summary: US biotech developing compact CRISPR systems for in-vivo editing and diagnostics.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Mammoth Biosciences works on compact Cas enzymes that can be delivered more easily into tissues, and on CRISPR-based diagnostics. Its smaller editors may fit into viral vectors that full-size Cas9 cannot. The company partners with larger pharma for delivery and development.

Technology Exposure

  • Compact CRISPR editors
  • In-vivo gene editing
  • CRISPR diagnostics

What To Watch

  • Delivery validation
  • Partnership progress
  • Funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
